english.q: What is 12 times 12?
english.text:
To find the result of 12 times 12, you can use the multiplication formula:

$$12 \times 12 = 144$$

Alternatively, you can calculate it by expanding 12 into $(10 + 2)$:
$$(10 + 2) \times 12 = (10 \times 12) + (2 \times 12) = 120 + 24 = 144$$

The answer is **144**.

english.q: What is the largest planet in our solar system?
english.text:
The largest planet in our solar system is **Jupiter**.

It is a gas giant that is so massive that all the other planets combined weigh less than Jupiter itself. Jupiter is approximately 11 times wider than Earth and has a mass roughly 318 times greater than Earth's. Its immense size makes it the most dominant object in our solar system, and it also accounts for more than 99% of the total mass of all the planets.

english.q: What is the boiling point of water in Celsius?

english.q: Which ocean is the largest?
english.text:
The **Pacific Ocean** is the largest ocean in the world.

It covers approximately 63 million square miles (165.25 million square kilometers), which is about 30% of the total Earth's surface and roughly 46% of the ocean surface. This makes it not only the biggest but also the deepest ocean, with the Challenger Deep being its deepest point.

For comparison, the second-largest is the Atlantic Ocean, followed by the Indian Ocean, the Southern Ocean, and the Arctic Ocean.
